blind_target.title: The retrospective gambler’s fallacy: Unlikely events, constructing the past, and multiple universes.
blind_target.evidence_quote: To help indicate the overall quality of our replication attempt, we included as a positive control an additional experiment with a well-defined effect size. Specifically, we used the retrospective gambler’s task (Oppenheimer & Monin, 2009).
blind_target.outcome_quote: To allay such concerns, we used a positive control, the retrospective gambler’s fallacy (Oppenheimer & Monin, 2009). In all cases, we observed the expected pattern of results.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The positive-control experiment re-tests the specifically attributed published finding in new samples, and the authors state that its expected pattern occurred in all cases. Klein et al. supplied materials and prior evidence; the paper names Oppenheimer and Monin as the finding tested.

luna_triage.reason: The source identifies an experiment used as a positive control by its published finding and citation; it explicitly reports the expected pattern in the retest. Supplied row 1078 is Eskine (2012), a different original. Oppenheimer and Monin (2009) is therefore an additional replication–original pair.
